sources.author: Fakh
patch_list: Stops the Google Play license check from blocking the patched app with a "Get this app from Play" screen.
Makes "Continue with Google" work by signing in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.
Unlocks the client-side Premium checks, which also removes ads.
Adds the themed app icon of Android 13 and later, which follows the wallpaper colors.
